title: Three Day Manhunt Ends as Officer Shoots Fleeing Suspect Inside Vehicle
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Reno, Nevada — On Saturday, November 16, 2024, just before 11 p.m., Reno Police Officers conducted a traffic stop on an unlicensed, gray Suburban at Sutro. The driver of the vehicle, 25-year-old Kristopher Gari, had a revoked driver's license and a warrant for his arrest. Officers asked Kristopher to exit the vehicle to detain him, while confirming his warrant. While attempting to detain him, Kristopher resisted arrest and ultimately fled from officers in his vehicle. Officers were unable to locate Kristopher or the vehicle. Now in addition to the warrant, officers had probable cause to arrest Kristopher for eluding, resisting an officer and additional traffic charges. On Sunday, November 17, 2024, at approximately 7:30 a.m., officers responded to the 700 block of Twin Lakes Drive, on the report of a suspicious vehicle, parked on private property. When officers arrived on scene, they immediately realized that the suspicious vehicle was the same vehicle from the incident the day before. 

When Kristopher returned to his vehicle, officers attempted to conduct a traffic stop. Kristopher then fled from the stop, hitting several patrol cars while fleeing. Officers attempted to locate Kristopher in the vehicle in the area but were unable to. In addition to the charges Kristopher was wanted for from the incident the day prior, he was now additionally wanted for reckless driving, obstructing and resisting an officer and additional traffic charges. The following day, on Monday, November 18, 2024, just before 1:40 a.m., a Reno Police officer was on proactive Patrol in the area of 1010 West 4 Street, in a marked Reno Police vehicle. The officer saw the same vehicle that fled from the officers the two previous days, with Kristopher in the driver's seat. An officer attempted to take Kristopher into custody and entered his vehicle, in an attempt to keep him from fleeing and further endangering the public. 

While inside the vehicle, a physical fight occurred between Kristopher and the officer. During the fight, Kristopher ignored the officer's commands and drove off with the officer trapped inside the vehicle. Kristopher crashed the vehicle with the officer inside. The officer continued to attempt to detain him, however Kristopher continued to resist while trying to get the vehicle started again. Kristopher was able to start the vehicle and drove at a high rate of speed, with the officer still trapped inside. Kristopher then drove on the wrong side of the road, putting others in danger. In response, the officer drew his firearm, in an attempt to force Kristopher to stop the vehicle. Instead of stopping the vehicle, Kristopher then grabbed onto the officer's firearm. The officer managed to maintain control of his weapon and was ultimately forced to discharge it. Officers provided immediate life-saving measures, but Kristopher was ultimately pronounced deceased on scene.
